note: Series-signature music briefs for ACE-Step 1.5 (acegen.py). Each series has one identity (instrumentation and character, kept identical across its pieces so the sting and the bed sound like one family) in D or E major, the two keys the soundscape's tuned sounds come in. A sting is generated long and cut to its strongest opening by picksig.py; a bed is cut into a seamless beat-aligned loop. No named artists, songs, games or composers in any prompt: the music must not imitate anyone.
house: Instrumental only, no vocals, no choir, no spoken words. Clean modern mix, warm low end that still carries on a phone speaker, no harsh highs.

gta_daily.name: GTA 6 Day N
gta_daily.identity: Sun-drenched retro-modern synth funk: warm analogue synth bass, gated electronic drums, bright chorus guitar chops and a lush pad, the feeling of a hot coastal evening drive.

sting.caption: A confident four-second signature intro: one bold rising synth phrase that lands on a big warm final chord and rings out, like a show's title card.

bed.caption: Steady background groove for narration: consistent energy start to finish, no lead melody, no build-ups or drops, the midrange left clear for a voice.

why.name: The Why
why.identity: Curious, playful investigation: plucked pizzicato strings, soft marimba, a round muted synth bass and light brushed percussion, thoughtful and a little mischievous.

sting.caption: A short curious signature motif: three plucked notes that ask a question and a soft resolving chord answer, clean and memorable.

bed.caption: Light steady background bed for narration: even energy throughout, no lead melody, no breaks, gentle and unobtrusive.

gta_file.name: The GTA File
gta_file.identity: Neo-noir case file: low pulsing analogue synths, a ticking hi-hat, a deep sub bass and distant dark pads, serious and investigative with a warm undertone.

sting.caption: A tense signature opener: a low pulse that swells into one heavy dark chord with a short tail, like a case file slamming shut.

bed.caption: Steady investigative background bed for narration: even pulse throughout, no lead melody, no builds or drops, the midrange left clear.

pulse_lab.name: Pulse Lab
pulse_lab.identity: Bright experimental electronica: bubbling arpeggiated synths, soft glitch percussion, clean digital bleeps and a bouncy bass, playful and precise like a lab test.

sting.caption: A quick signature jingle: a sparkling ascending arpeggio that resolves on a bright clean chord, crisp and upbeat.

bed.caption: Steady background bed for narration: consistent energy, no lead melody, no drops or breakdowns, the midrange left clear for a voice.

receipts.name: Receipts
receipts.identity: Confident laid-back boom bap: a punchy dusty drum break, a warm electric piano, a round bass line and the odd vinyl crackle, cool and self-assured.

sting.caption: A punchy signature stamp: a drum fill into two hard stabs and a warm electric piano chord, short and decisive, like a verdict.

bed.caption: Steady head-nod background groove for narration: even energy, no lead melody, no breaks or drops, the midrange left clear.

docs.name: Documentaries
docs.identity: Warm cinematic documentary score: soft felt piano, sustained strings, a gentle low synth pulse and subtle timpani, reflective and grand without being loud.

sting.caption: A short cinematic signature: a soft swell of strings into one warm resolved piano and string chord that rings out, like a documentary title.

bed.caption: Steady documentary underscore for narration: even energy throughout, no lead melody, no crescendos, the midrange left clear for a voice.

rise.caption: A sixteen-second cue that builds steadily with strings and pulse and lands on one strong downbeat hit, then a short warm tail, to open a new chapter.
